therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CD20-targeted antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity combined with DNA alkylation and transcription inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: B-cell depletion and direct cytotoxicity in mantle cell lymphoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Previously untreated mantle cell lymphoma patients

biomarker_changes: MRD negative in 13/21 patients after induction
MRD negative in 10/21 patients post-consolidation (blood and marrow)
Concordance between peripheral blood and bone marrow MRD status in 14 patients
results.dose_information: Bendamustine and obinutuzumab induction for 6 cycles, followed by obinutuzumab consolidation (4 weekly doses), then obinutuzumab maintenance for 8 cycles

context.duration: Up to 15 months treatment, followed by up to 3 years follow-up
